_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. a reference sheet: a faded green 1993 Subaru Legacy wagon with one hubcap, a blue tarp in the back and a tiny spare tire, trailing a faint blue haze; an old small Datsun; a flatbed truck with a winch; a chrome two-group espresso machine; a giant thermos with paper cups; two wax-paper grease sacks of fried clams; a day-old maple bar; a paper tray of corn; a green-webbed folding lawn chair with a rusted frame. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
